summary.document_scope: Six chapters, all with synthetic genealogy tables and summary rows, with one chapter missing its source page. The document is structurally uniform except for three chapters with format or semantic issues: one with fragmented tables, one with concatenated context rows, one with a fused BOY/GIRL header, and one with a child note in the wrong column. One chapter has an unclassified note but insufficient evidence for semantic classification.
summary.default_note_policy: Notes and child/death events should be placed in their appropriate columns (child events in BOY/GIRL, death events in DIED), with summary/total tables separated from main genealogy tables. Subgroup/context rows should be single, non-concatenated rows. BOY and GIRL columns should remain distinct.
summary.default_note_policy_rationale: The majority of chapters (001, 002, 003, 005, 006) use the NAME|BORN|MARRIED|SPOUSE|BOY|GIRL|DIED header signature, with separate summary tables and single, non-concatenated context rows. Only one chapter (004) uses a fused BOY/GIRL header, and only one (003) has concatenated context rows. The dominant, most consistent pattern is with distinct BOY and GIRL columns and non-concatenated context rows.

pattern_conventions.label: Standard 7-column genealogy table with separate summary
allowed_variants: Multiple genealogy tables only if each is a legitimate family group, not fragmentation
